stages.label: Cliff, sea and retaining walls
stages.description: Raise the stepped cliff from the sea, face each bench with a retaining wall and cut the ravine.

stages.label: Houses and towers
stages.description: Rasterise each house as a storeyed shell with bays, then give it a gable roof or a roof terrace.

stages.label: Stairs, paths and bridges
stages.description: Pave the bench tops, climb each retaining wall with a switchback stair, cross the ravine, open doors to the street.

stages.label: Rule-driven growth
stages.description: Rules choose small deep windows, plant the retaining walls and grow roof gardens.

stages.label: Constraint checks
stages.description: Walk from the quay to every house; check the ravine stays open, headroom and support.

stages.label: Architectural detailing
stages.description: Olive trees, potted plants and street lamps.
